name: aspencrm-ai
description: Work an Aspen CRM through its hosted MCP connector: explore the model, read, search and report on records, create, update, bulk-update and delete them, attach files, and merge duplicate contacts. Every write is approved in the host.

interface.shortDescription: Explore, report on and update Aspen CRM records through the instance's hosted MCP.
interface.longDescription: Explore the model, read, search and report on Aspen CRM records, create, update, bulk-update and delete them, attach files, and merge duplicate contacts, through the instance's hosted MCP server. Add that server to Codex separately; this plugin carries the know-how, not the connection.
defaultPrompt: Explore my Aspen CRM and summarize open work
